a7292.name: Hamas (statement)
a7292.speech: Said that Netanyahu's behaviour clearly violates article 14 of the agreement, which provides that all measures linked to the first phase continue into the second phase.

a7292.speaker: Hamas (statement)
a7292.name: Hamas (statement)
a7292.speech: Stressed that Israel's allegations concerning the movement's violation of the ceasefire agreement are misleading and baseless and constitute “a failed attempt to conceal the daily and systematic violations of the agreement” ; Hamas explained that the Israeli violations of the ceasefire agreement have led to the deaths of more than 100 people in Gaza, to the disruption of the humanitarian protocol, to the prevention of the entry of shelters and relief supplies and to the worsening of the humanitarian catastrophe.

a7292.speaker: Hamas (statement)
a7292.name: Hamas (statement)
a7292.speech: “Netanyahu is trying to disengage from the signed ceasefire agreement, in order to serve his narrow political calculations at the expense of the Israeli prisoners in Gaza and of their lives” ; The movement holds “Netanyahu and his extremist government responsible for obstructing the implementation of the agreement or for any folly he might commit in denouncing it, including the humanitarian consequences relating to the occupation's prisoners” ; “the only way to free the occupation's prisoners is to adhere to the agreement, to begin negotiations immediately in order to start the second phase and for the occupation to commit to implementing its obligations.”

a7292.speaker: Hamas (statement)
a7292.name: Hamas (statement)
a7292.speech: Reiterated its commitment to implementing the signed agreement in three stages and its willingness to begin negotiations on the second stage of the agreement ; Hamas rejects this proposal and demands that Israel respect the provisions of the ceasefire agreement, and calls on the mediators to begin negotiations immediately for the second phase, which includes an Israeli withdrawal from the Gaza Strip and a complete halt to the war.

a7292.speaker: Office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (statement on X)
a7292.name: Office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (statement on X)
a7292.speech: “With the completion of the first stage of the agreement on the captives, and in light of Hamas's refusal to accept the plan of (the American president's special envoy to the Middle East Steve) Witkoff to continue the negotiations, the prime minister has decided that as of this morning (Sunday) all goods and supplies will cease entering the Gaza Strip.”

a7292.speaker: Office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (statement)
a7292.name: Office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (statement)
a7292.speech: Said, during the night from Saturday to Sunday, that “Israel has accepted the broad outlines of a plan proposed by the American envoy Steve Witkoff for a temporary ceasefire during the month of Ramadan and the Jewish festival of Passover (from 12 to 20 April)” ; According to the Israeli statement, under this plan half of the Israeli detainees in Gaza, living and dead, will be released on the first day of the proposed truce. The statement adds that “in the event of the conclusion of a permanent ceasefire agreement, the other half of the detainees in Gaza will be released.”

a7292.speaker: Egyptian and Qatari mediators and Steve Witkoff, US envoy (non-response)
a7292.name: Egyptian and Qatari mediators and Steve Witkoff
a7292.title: US envoy (non-response)
a7292.speech: The Egyptian and Qatari mediators, as well as Witkoff, made no immediate comment on the Israeli announcement.

a7292.speaker: Hebrew media
a7292.name: Hebrew media
a7292.speech: Tel Aviv estimates that there are 62 Israeli prisoners in Gaza (living and dead), according to the Hebrew media, while the Palestinian factions have not announced the number of prisoners they were holding.

a7375.speaker: Experts (unnamed)
a7375.name: Experts (unnamed)
a7375.speech: Say the adoption of US dollar-pegged tariffs for telecommunication services could boost the sector's capacity to invest in critical infrastructure.

a7375.speaker: Postal and Telecommunication Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (Potraz)
a7375.name: Postal and Telecommunication Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (Potraz)
a7375.speech: Approved a 100 percent industry-wide Zimbabwe dollar tariff increase with effect from November 1, 2023, saying the move was necessary to ensure the viability...
